summary: We tried to built an interactive web app where a school aged student can learn about all the rovers sent ever by NASA. By playing this game, he will spontaneously know and explore the rovers and space and he can also upgrade his curiosity. We developed two modes. In game mode, he can learn by playing game. And in explore mode he can learn formally.
details: Our project is mainly separated into two segments. One being a game and the other being a solar map. Players can play our game and learn about the abondoned rovers and machines on the moon and mars while enjoying the gameplay to its fullest. This encourages younger players and holds their attention for longer. We are creating a game where the player is an AI integrated rover which has been given a mission to bring back the golden record from the voyager 1 while rescuing the broken rovers and machines on the moon and mars. So he will go there and rebuild them from broken parts and make friends with them. This helps them learn their locations and structures. They will talk to the fixed machines and they will tell them about their history and they will also log into the mind and replay the broken machine's missions too. They will do the tasks that the broken machines were given. This will help them learn about their history too. the other part called the solar map is an interactive map of our solar system by which they can track the machine's locations as well as learn about their histories and see them in real life. This will help them learn anything they might have missed in the gameplay as if they wanna go to the next level in the game they will face challenges and asked questions about the machines they have saved. So this will force the players to recall their memories and learn about the machines.
